description: Similar name, same sex, age +/-1, same district, different partner
likely_cause: No unique beneficiary ID across partners
recommended_action: Introduce a shared beneficiary ID (e.g., national ID or programme card); quarterly cross-partner de-duplication

description: More than one submission for the same household and round
recommended_action: Enable duplicate-instance detection on the server; train enumerators to confirm sync before re-sending

description: Maize yield outside 150-8,000 kg/ha
recommended_action: Add explicit unit selectors, auto-convert, and a yield plausibility warning at entry

description: HH size outside 1-20 or respondent age outside 15-95
likely_cause: No constraints on household size / age
recommended_action: Add range constraints; require confirmation for HH size >15

description: Frequency answered when occurrence=No, or missing when Yes
likely_cause: Missing relevance logic on HHS follow-ups
recommended_action: Fix relevance conditions in the form; add server-side validation

description: All five rCSI items identical and non-zero
recommended_action: Shorten the module, reorder items, spot-check audio audits on rCSI

description: Robust z-score >3.5 vs district-round median
recommended_action: Review outliers with supervisors; add soft yield-range warnings

description: Land area >40% from the household's own median across rounds
recommended_action: Pre-load baseline land area; flag >30% change at entry

description: Coordinates outside the district bounding box
likely_cause: GPS taken away from the household / fabrication
recommended_action: Require GPS accuracy <20 m and geofence to the assigned district

description: Coordinates within 300 m of the district field office
recommended_action: Add geofence exclusion around offices; back-check affected interviews

description: Sex in training log differs from household roster
likely_cause: Coding errors when transcribing sex from register
recommended_action: Validate against registry at entry; train partner data clerks

description: Food-group or coping days outside 0-7
likely_cause: No hard constraints on numeric fields
recommended_action: Add constraint 0<=days<=7 (and soft warnings on totals) to the XLSForm; redeploy

description: Pregnancy answer for non-eligible respondent
likely_cause: Outdated form version still in use
recommended_action: Force form-version update; block submissions from old versions

description: Submission date earlier than interview date
recommended_action: Lock date to server time; flag mismatches at upload

description: Interview date outside round window (+/-7 days) or before programme start
likely_cause: Wrong device clock or backdated entry
recommended_action: Lock date to device time; sync and verify device clocks daily

description: Reported total differs from raw count by >5%
recommended_action: Require partners to submit disaggregated raw logs with every report; MEL team computes totals

description: Submitted >7 days after interview
recommended_action: Introduce a 72-hour sync rule and a daily submission dashboard

description: Submission from a form version other than the latest
likely_cause: Form update not rolled out to all devices
recommended_action: Run a pre-fieldwork device audit

description: Female + male differs from reported total
recommended_action: Use locked report template with formula checks

description: >=5% missing and missingness varies with a wealth proxy
recommended_action: Use consumption/asset proxies, reorder question, report missingness rates; apply weighting or multiple imputation

description: Enumerator-round median duration <60% of overall median
likely_cause: Targets / pressure; interviews not actually conducted
recommended_action: Re-interview all affected households; suspend enumerator pending review; reassess incentives

description: SD of FCS in an enumerator-round <50% of the pooled SD
recommended_action: Include in re-interview scope; review audio audits

description: Re-interview disagrees with original on >=30% of key items
likely_cause: Back-check confirms data cannot be reproduced
recommended_action: Replace affected interviews; escalate per code of conduct

description: >20% of an enumerator-round's records share an identical FCS+rCSI answer vector with >=2 others
recommended_action: Re-interview all affected households; suspend enumerator; exclude data from analysis until verified

description: Cumulative attrition >10% or differential by baseline welfare
recommended_action: Intensify tracking protocols; apply attrition weights; run bounds sensitivity analysis

description: Excess share of land at 0.5 ha multiples / production at 50 kg multiples
recommended_action: Use crop-cutting or measured land for a sub-sample; use local-unit calibration
